mapper.update: UPDATE onsite_sales_policies osp JOIN fair_dates fd ON fd.fair_date_id = osp.fair_date_id SET osp.reserved_count = osp.reserved_count + 1 WHERE fd.fair_id = #{fairId} AND fd.operation_date = #{visitDate} AND (osp.capacity IS NULL OR osp.reserved_count < osp.capacity)

UPDATE onsite_sales_policies osp JOIN fair_dates fd ON fd.fair_date_id = osp.fair_date_id SET osp.reserved_count = osp.reserved_count - 1 WHERE fd.fair_id = #{fairId} AND fd.operation_date = #{visitDate} AND osp.reserved_count > 0
